image_spec.headline: About 40% of the food tossed on Thanksgiving is turkey.
image_spec.body: That's out of an estimated 320 million pounds of food wasted in a single day.

posts.caption:
Thanksgiving is two weeks out, so here's a number to chew on. ReFED estimates about 320 million pounds of food got thrown away on Thanksgiving last year, and around 40% of it was turkey.

Nobody plans to waste the turkey. It just sits in the fridge behind the pie until Monday, and by then nobody's sure about it anymore.

Our plan this year is a smaller bird and leftovers eaten by Sunday. 🍗

What's your favorite thing to make with leftover turkey? Share it in the comments.
